key_insight: Using higher-dimensional quantum units called qudits can increase information capacity per carrier and naturally encode high-dimensional systems for quantum simulation.
engineering_relevance: Qudits offer a route to extracting more processing capability from a fixed number of quantum carriers, provided reliable multilevel control and readout are available.
method: Review experimental progress in qudit preparation, control, and measurement.
Compare trapped ions, superconducting circuits, nuclear spins, photonics, and neutral atoms.
Survey early demonstrations of qudit simulation, computation, and error suppression.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports high-fidelity experimental progress and early application demonstrations but provides no numerical benchmarks.
watch_item: Scalable qudit processing remains challenging, and higher-dimensional encoding does not eliminate decoherence or the need for fault tolerance.
paper_title: Quditology: harnessing many levels for quantum information processing
